intro: Delicate Instruments is a quest in Elwynn Forest given by Hamish Bergwort at the Tower of Azora. Hamish's sensitive arcane equipment is being disrupted by erratic magical surges radiating from the north. To restore stability, travelers must enter Jasperlode Mine and cull the kobold geomancers responsible for the disturbances.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy.
The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, my friend. Let me try my calibrations again...
